verdict.rationale: Kushki documents recurring and scheduled charges ("Crea un cargo recurrente", "Maneja tus cargos calendarizados"), but nothing in the evidence pack describes automatic retries of failed subscription payments, dunning logic, or recovery emails. Recurring billing is a related feature, not the retry and dunning capability this story asks for. The axis applies to a payments product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails
